events.name: Andy Gross
events.info: ANDY GROSS - COMEDY, MAGIC & VENTRILOQUISM Andy Gross is a comedian, magician and ventriloquist with over 1 billion online views, more than 1 million social media followers and his own comedy special on Amazon Prime. He has become one of the most recognizable comedy magicians in the country. A veteran headliner performing more than 200 shows a year, Andy has entertained audiences around the world with his unique mix of hilarious comedy, incredible magic, audience participation and unforgettable characters. Andy is also one of only a handful of performers in the world who can truly ''throw'' his voice an incredible ventriloquism skill that has to be seen and heard to be believed. His live show is fast-paced, interactive, unpredictable and unlike anything else you'll see.
